Currently it never happens that a netdevice that is already a bridge slave
would suddenly become mlxsw upper. The only case where this might be
possible as far as mlxsw is concerned
column2: is with LAG netdevices. But if a LAG

column1: has any upper (e.g. is enslaved)
column2: enlaving mlxsw port to that LAG is

column1: forbidden. Thus the only way to install a LAG between a bridge and a mlxsw
port is by first enslaving the port to the LAG
to a bridge. At that point there are no bridge objects (such as port VLANs)
to replay. Those are added afterwards
column2: and notified as they are created.

column1: This holds even for the PVID.
However in the following patches
column2: the requirement that ports be only

column1: enslaved to masters without uppers
column2: is going to be relaxed. It will

column1: therefore be necessary to replay the existing bridge objects. Without this
replay
column2: e.g. the mlxsw bridge_port_vlan objects are not instantiated

column1: causes issues later
column2: as a lot of code relies on their presence.

column1: To that end
column2: add a new notifier block whose sole role is to filter out

column1: events related to the one relevant upper
column2: and forward those to the existing

column1: switchdev notifier block. Pass the new notifier block to
switchdev_bridge_port_offload() when the bridge port is created.
